steps.title: 準備與安全
steps.objective: 說明氣管插管的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where Endotracheal intubation applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：預給氧、喉鏡操作、確認（EtCO2）與困難氣道準備。

steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 限制

steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.

steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟

steps.title: 評估與準備（SOAP-ME）
steps.objective: 完成氣道評估與器材準備。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete airway assessment and equipment preparation.
steps.instruction: LEMON 評估（外觀、3-3-2、Mallampati、阻塞、頸活動）；準備抽吸、氧氣、氣道工具（喉鏡、影像喉鏡、探條、聲門上氣道）、藥物與監測。
steps.instructionEn: LEMON assessment (look, 3-3-2, Mallampati, obstruction, neck mobility); prepare suction, oxygen, airway devices (laryngoscope, videolaryngoscope, bougie, supraglottic airway), drugs and monitoring.
steps.observation: 口述困難氣道計畫 A–D。
steps.observationEn: Verbalise plans A–D.
steps.failure: 沒有備援計畫就開始是最危險的狀態。
steps.failureEn: Starting without a backup plan is the most dangerous state.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Checklist complete.

knowledge.title: Vortex 模型
knowledge.text: 面罩、聲門上、氣管內管三條路徑各最多三次嘗試，否則前頸切開。
knowledge.textEn: Face mask, supraglottic and tube: up to three attempts each, then front-of-neck access.

steps.title: 預給氧與擺位
steps.objective: 最大化氧儲備並擺出嗅物位。
steps.objectiveEn: Maximise oxygen reserve and achieve the sniffing position.
steps.instruction: 100% 氧 3 分鐘或 8 次深呼吸（EtO2 > 90%），鼻導管 15 L/min 持續給氧；肥胖者頭高位（耳與胸骨切跡同水平）。
steps.instructionEn: 100% oxygen for 3 minutes or 8 deep breaths (EtO2 > 90%), apnoeic oxygenation via nasal cannula 15 L/min; ramped position for the obese (ear level with the sternal notch).
steps.observation: 確認 EtO2／SpO2。
steps.observationEn: Confirm EtO2/SpO2.
steps.failure: 預給氧不足使安全無呼吸時間大幅縮短。
steps.failureEn: Poor pre-oxygenation drastically shortens safe apnoea time.
steps.check: 氧儲備最大化。
steps.checkEn: Oxygen reserve maximised.

knowledge.title: 無呼吸氧合
knowledge.text: 延長去飽和時間。
knowledge.textEn: Prolongs time to desaturation.

quiz.question: 「預給氧與擺位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 誘導與肌肉鬆弛
steps.objective: 給予誘導藥與肌鬆劑。
steps.objectiveEn: Give induction agent and relaxant.
steps.instruction: propofol 1.5–2.5 mg/kg（或 ketamine／etomidate 於血流動力學不穩）；rocuronium 1.2 mg/kg 或 succinylcholine 1–1.5 mg/kg；等待 45–60 秒。
steps.instructionEn: Propofol 1.5–2.5 mg/kg (or ketamine/etomidate when unstable); rocuronium 1.2 mg/kg or succinylcholine 1–1.5 mg/kg; wait 45–60 s.
steps.observation: 確認下頜鬆弛。
steps.observationEn: Confirm jaw relaxation.
steps.failure: 肌鬆未完全即插管造成聲帶損傷與失敗。
steps.failureEn: Intubating before full relaxation injures the cords and fails.
steps.check: 誘導完成。
steps.checkEn: Induction complete.

knowledge.title: Sugammadex
knowledge.text: 可在 3 分鐘內逆轉 rocuronium。
knowledge.textEn: Reverses rocuronium within 3 minutes.

quiz.question: 「誘導與肌肉鬆弛」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 喉鏡操作與置管
steps.objective: 顯露聲門並置入氣管內管。
steps.objectiveEn: Expose the glottis and place the tube.
steps.instruction: 左手持喉鏡自右口角入，撥舌向左，葉片尖端至會厭谷，沿把手方向上提（不翹）；見聲門後右手送管至 cuff 過聲帶 2 cm，深度約 21（女）／23（男）cm；必要時探條或 BURP。
steps.instructionEn: Laryngoscope in the left hand from the right of the mouth, sweep the tongue left, tip in the vallecula, lift along the handle (do not lever); pass the tube until the cuff is 2 cm past the cords, about 21 (female)/23 (male) cm; use a bougie or BURP as needed.
steps.observation: 記錄 Cormack-Lehane 分級。
steps.observationEn: Record the Cormack–Lehane grade.
steps.failure: 超過 30 秒或 SpO2 下降即停止並面罩通氣。
steps.failureEn: Stop and mask-ventilate after 30 s or desaturation.
steps.check: 管子通過聲門。
steps.checkEn: Tube through the cords.

knowledge.title: 影像喉鏡
knowledge.text: 提高首次成功率，是許多單位的首選。
knowledge.textEn: Improves first-pass success and is first-line in many units.

steps.title: 確認位置與固定
steps.objective: 確認氣管內位置並固定。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm tracheal placement and secure.
steps.instruction: 持續 EtCO2 波形 ≥ 5 次呼吸、雙側呼吸音、胸廓對稱起伏；cuff 壓 20–30 cmH2O；固定於門齒刻度並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Sustained EtCO2 waveform for ≥ 5 breaths, bilateral breath sounds, symmetrical chest rise; cuff 20–30 cmH2O; secure at the incisor mark and record.
steps.observation: 拍攝胸部 X 光（ICU）。
steps.observationEn: Chest X-ray in the ICU.
steps.failure: 食道插管未被發現是致命的：EtCO2 是金標準。
steps.failureEn: Unrecognised oesophageal intubation is lethal: EtCO2 is the gold standard.
steps.check: EtCO2 確認、固定完成。
steps.checkEn: EtCO2 confirmed and tube secured.

knowledge.title: 右主支氣管插管
knowledge.text: 單側呼吸音與深度過深提示退管。
knowledge.textEn: Unilateral breath sounds and excessive depth: withdraw.

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.

steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.

steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率

stages.description: 快速誘導插管的操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of Rapid sequence induction.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：藥物選擇（ketamine／rocuronium）
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「藥物選擇（ketamine／rocuronium）」在快速誘導插管中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Drug selection (ketamine/rocuronium)' within Rapid sequence induction, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「藥物選擇（ketamine／rocuronium）」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Drug selection (ketamine/rocuronium)': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「藥物選擇（ketamine／rocuronium）」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Drug selection (ketamine/rocuronium)'.
steps.failure: 若「藥物選擇（ketamine／rocuronium）」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Drug selection (ketamine/rocuronium)' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「藥物選擇（ketamine／rocuronium）」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Drug selection (ketamine/rocuronium)' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「藥物選擇（ketamine／rocuronium）」是快速誘導插管的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
